name: XCC_TR_BALANCES
description: This table temporarily stores the balance updates for each budgetary control validation request until they get asynchronously posted to the budgetary control balances in XCC_BALANCES.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the unique identifier of the budgetary control validation run for which balances changes are being tracked.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Identifies the control budget ID for which balances are being tracked.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Identifies the budget account ID for which balance changes are being tracked.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the period name for which balance changes are being tracked.

columns.name: BALANCES_POSTED_FLAG
columns.description: Status of the transfer to XCC_BALANCES. Values can be either Y or N.

columns.name: BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the budget balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the budget adjustment balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the commitment balance because of the budgetary control validation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the obligation balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the other type of consumption balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the actual expenditure balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAILABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the available budget balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: APPROVED_COMMITMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the approved commitment balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: APPROVED_AUTHORIZATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the approved authorization balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: APPROVED_OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the approved obligation balance because of the budgetary control validation.

columns.name: VALIDATED_PAYABLES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the validated payables balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: APPROVED_PROJECT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the approved project balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: DETAIL_OTHER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the encumbrance balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: UNRELEASED_BUDGET_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the unreleased budget balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_PAYABLES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the accounted payables balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_RECEIPTS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the accounted receipts balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_PROJECT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the accounted project balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: MISC_EXPENDITURES_AMOUNT
columns.description: Change to the miscellaneous expenditure balance because of budgetary control validation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
